Return the hardcoded list of countries currently eligible for KYC
onboarding (mutual Stripe ∩ Bridge support — Stripe Connect card-payments
capability + Bridge allowed). Each entry is tagged with a
`kyc_supported` boolean (always `true` in the current response). The list
is open — no authentication required. Source list: RCS-453.
